question: In a certain code language, FUTILE is written as UFITEL, and SELDOM is written as ESDLMO. How will CORTEX be written in that lanuguage?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

**Logic : The letter's position is interchanged in pairs i.e**

 
• **First two letter's position is interchanged with each other.**
 
• **Next two letters i.e third and fourth letter's position is interchanged with each other.**
 
• Next two letters i.e fifth and sixth letter's &l
